AC verification (self-check):
- dd-2 cycle markers: FAIL (count=0, expected 1..4)
- dd-3 arbiter comment: FAIL (count=0, expected exactly 1)
- dd-4 BLOCK check status: FAIL (llm-review=SUCCESS but because review SKIPPED, not BLOCK resolved)
- dd-5 DEFER orphan ticket: FAIL (no orphan ticket created)
- dd-6 DROP defense record: FAIL (no defense record on PR or tracker)
- progress notes recorded: PASS (all baseline keys written)
- cycle_marker_count_baseline recorded: PASS (0)
- orphan_count_baseline recorded: PASS (0)

STATUS: fail — all three ruling types MISSING. Persistent skip behavior confirmed despite reviewable file addition. Escalation required.

Platform diagnosis: verify-session-provenance.sh treats commits on the session PR as provenanced because the GitHub /commits/{sha}/pulls API returns the session PR itself. The script cannot distinguish 'reviewed sub-PR' from 'the current session PR'. Adding files directly to the sc10-evidence branch does not escape this provenance check — any commit on that branch will be associated with PR #253 and therefore marked provenanced.
